contract: navigation.md: design-only admin mockup; 360x800 and 1280x900; synthetic local data; lifecycle of roles, users and read-only preview; no production API

accessibility.evidence: The defined mockup checks passed: visible keyboard focus, mobile menu focus/Escape return, native modal card, preview focus and return; axe-core 4.14.0 on the users view reported 0 violations and 0 incomplete at both sizes. This is a limited mockup sample, not full product WCAG or screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: Users, six content states and an 81-character display name fit 360x800 and 1280x900 without document overflow. Mobile menu begins closed. Visual inspection found and corrected a desktop preview grid sizing issue; rerun verifies preview uses full workspace.

loading.evidence: State selector shows loading explanation, hides stale content and provides a return to the ready mockup.

empty.evidence: Empty example has an explanatory message and an explicit next step; recovery restores ready content.

error.evidence: Error state displays a retry action; recovery changes to ready without falsely implying a backend request succeeded.

partial.evidence: Partial-data state labels the missing portion, keeps a reduced synthetic user list and offers recovery.

success.evidence: Success states explicitly state local memory-only changes; the list remains available and recovery is visible.

permission.evidence: No-access state clears content, explains the boundary and permits safe return; preview hides admin navigation and its write controls are disabled. Real server permissions are not implemented.

renderedEvidence.observation: Readable mobile user cards and initially closed navigation.
Desktop navigation, active users section and labelled search/actions.
Created and renamed role, capability matrix and refusal to delete an assigned role.
Full-width read-only preview after admin navigation is hidden; clear target and return control.
